args.text: Can you pull every ticket and feature request on Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Driftmoor Marine Freight from the Coastal channels and Moss's Coastal notes, labelled by account? Leave Pellow Home Living out even though it shares the PHL code. I need the list for Kwame's account review.

args.query: Pellucid Harbor Logistics OR Driftmoor Marine Freight

args.text:
Bettina, here's what I found for Kwame's account review. Sources: #coastal-team, #coastal-random and Moss's Coastal digests/cheat sheet.

Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast)
- Ticket #4419: Yard_Dwell_Summary report times out when filtered by container length. Open. (Moss's Coastal cheat sheet)

Driftmoor Marine Freight (Puget Sound)
- Feature request #882: bulk-clear button for departed barges, requested by their warehouse managers. (Coastal cheat sheet)
- Ticket #4419: barge slip 7 schedule sync. Driftmoor also asked for a patched manifest CSV before the 06:00 shift. (Moss's 2025-11-02 digest)
- No ticket number: the Terminal B tide-table import macro failed, and engineering gave the night dispatcher a manual CSV patch. (Coastal cheat sheet)

Check before the review: #4419 shows up on both accounts. The cheat sheet ties it to Pellucid's report timeout. The 11/2 digest ties it to Driftmoor's slip 7 sync. They may be two different tickets sharing a number, or one of the notes may have the wrong number. Please confirm in the ticketing system.

Outside the sources you named: your 2025-12-08 cutover note lists ticket #PD-8841 for Pellucid, about chassis pool holds on double-booked gates at Gate 4B.

Left out: Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark), including #8812 and PD-4821. The channels had no other tickets or requests for these two accounts. I didn't see ticket-system data, so anything not mentioned in those channels or notes won't be on this list.

I posted the list as a reply in the #coastal-team thread.

**Pellucid Harbor Logistics**
- Ticket #4419: the `Yard_Dwell_Summary` report times out when filtered by container length. It is open. This comes from Moss's cheat sheet.
- Ticket #PD-8841: chassis pool holds on double-booked gates at Gate 4B. This comes from Bettina's own 2025-12-08 cutover note. It wasn't in the sources she named, so I flagged it separately.

**Driftmoor Marine Freight**
- Feature request #882: a bulk-clear button for departed barges, requested by their warehouse managers.
- Ticket #4419: barge slip 7 schedule sync, plus a request for a patched manifest CSV before the 06:00 shift. This comes from Moss's 2025-11-02 digest.
- The Terminal B tide-table import macro failure has no ticket number. Engineering gave the night dispatcher a manual CSV patch.

Ticket #4419 appears under both accounts with different descriptions. I told Bettina to confirm in the ticketing system whether these are two tickets sharing a number or one of the notes has the wrong number.

I left out Pellow Home Living, including #8812 and PD-4821. I also told her I couldn't see ticket-system data, so the list only covers what the channels and notes mention.
